items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Gaines himself, I knew him.

ctx.x: Philadelphia itself contributed a lot of great musicians to us.

Oh, sure. Louis Jordan came from there. That great band, was a little nine-piece band, Charlie Gaines, that Louis Jordan came from that band. The band used to sing. They used to sing harmony and different things like that, you know. It was a very entertaining band.

But Louis is the only -- Charlie Gaines himself, I knew him. He was a trumpet player and I knew Louis. I didn't know the rest of the guys too well. But Louis Jordan, he left there to go to Chick Webb.
